scope: Ordinary local startup on Windows with a fresh isolated PostgreSQL database.
checks: Fresh and concurrent initializations generate stable independent keys. Existing dotenv content is preserved byte-for-byte, including when the previous master key entry is absent.
The Docker Compose CLI resolves the generated configuration. API, worker and beat all require successful database preparation.
cmd.exe executes both batch launchers with isolated dependencies. Simulated migration failure returns nonzero before application startup.
Readiness fault injection covers storage, web login, API proxy and the named worker. Windows shutdown stops the launched process tree while an unrelated test process remains alive.
limits: Docker Desktop's Linux engine was unavailable. This check did not run a complete container stack, real Web/Redis/Qdrant/worker integration or a model call.
